Messages.Author: Inky
Messages.Body:
Ghoul Retainer - 2 lifes
Each round of combat, may strike for 1 hand damage or use a weapon the
vampire it is on is not using

White Phosphorous Grenade - 2R, aggravated
Bearer receives 1 aggravated, if used at close range

my question: if Ghoul Retainer uses White Phosporous Grenade during close
range combat, is the damage for close range combat applied to the retainer's
employer or not at all since retainers can only be damaged by long range
combat effects? or more concisely, is the bearer of the weapon still
considered the retainer's employer?

TIA

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:

The bearer of the weapon is the person holding it. Retainers can't hold
weapons. The vampire still takes the damage.

-Chris
